title: What can a nest tell us?
hook: Fossils can preserve more than bones.

knows: Some animals reproduce by laying eggs.
doesNotKnow: Separate an observation of a fossil nest from an inference about parental behavior.

misconception: A fossil nest by itself proves parental care for all dinosaurs.
objective: Separate an observation of a fossil nest from an inference about parental behavior.

claims.text: Fossils can preserve more than bones. An identified fossil nest contains several fossilized eggs. What does that observation directly establish? The indicated fossil nest contains several eggs together. That observation is evidence of eggs in the nest; it does not on its own establish the identity or behavior of a parent, or nesting behavior for every dinosaur.
